report.summary: Patient P-D011 (34, commercial high-deductible plan, no transport benefit, home tract 17031062000) was screened today for transportation needs. CMS screener (2026-10-26) reports no transportation barrier to appointments. No confirmed upcoming facility-based appointment could be transit-checked (no facility location on file). Tract profile: 47.6% of households lack a vehicle, 88 transit stops within 800 m with early-morning service, suggesting public transit is broadly available. Eligibility screening: Medicaid Ride Line — not eligible (commercial insurance); Senior Shuttle — not eligible (under 60); ADA Paratransit — potentially eligible only if disability certification obtained (up to 21 days); RideWell Medical Transport — private-pay option, booking handled externally.
